t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes colour related to its rate. If you notice one colour is giving you the higher rate - keep going with this until the rates switch and then try to find the colour giving the higher rate. The gnomes come in different colour pairs.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes come in a set of pairs - each pair usually consists of the same colours eg. pink and green or orange and brown. Try to figure out initially which of the 2 colours in the pair gives you the higher score and then stick with this colour. Some times the rates change and then you need to try to find the colour which is then giving you a higher rate. If you have picked the right gnome - your score increases in the top right, if you haven't, the score doesn't change.
